newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nuclear safety offices should be unified - official.
newsitem.headline: Nuclear safety offices should be unified - official.

text.p: Regulatory offices in charge of nuclear safety should be integrated into an independent body as part of a government restructuring, Hidenao Nakagawa, head of the Agency of Science and Technology, told reporters on Thursday.

Currently, a section for nuclear safety inspection in the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) conducts an initial safety examination for the construction of commercial nuclear power plants.
The results of the examination are reviewed by the Nuclear Safety Commission, the prime minister's advisory body, for double-checking before construction is permitted.
"My personal idea is probably we should integrate these organisations into one, and make it into a single, independent regulatory organisation," Nakagawa said.
He did not go into the details.
